input_format: Pinned upstream PromptUtils.format_context(context, question, en); tokenizer(prompt, raw_answer) pair with special tokens
source_policy: All visible audit bodies in manifest order, including duplicates; no extra retrieval or references
history_policy: actual_history not submitted; upstream QA interface has no history field; current query remains verbatim
answer_policy: Original answer verbatim, including citations/code/formatting; citation overlap marked separately
length_policy: Single full pair count; no truncation or chunking; over-limit remains not_covered
prediction_policy: Per-answer-token argmax of two class probabilities, ties choose 0; no tuned threshold
span_policy: Merge consecutive class-1 answer tokens; confidence=max class-1 probability within that span only
offset_policy: Fast tokenizer sequence_ids==1 and non-special nonempty offsets; preserve direct answer-relative offsets, no subtraction of first offset
interpretation: Unsupported-token diagnostic; not Atomic verdicts, five-dimensional scores, semantic certainty, or formal quality acceptance
